description: Authored speaker layout for the bundled guided-tutorial sample. Voices/text are hand-written (clean-room, CC0); per-utterance start/end are filled in by tools/generate_tutorial_audio.py from the actual synthesized timeline and MUST NOT be edited by hand.

utterances.label: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: Welcome to the walkthrough. I'll be your first speaker for this short demo, and I'll speak a few times so the tool has plenty to work with.

utterances.label: SPEAKER_01
utterances.text: Hi everyone, I'm Priya, and I'll be the second voice joining the conversation today.

utterances.label: SPEAKER_02
utterances.text: And I'm just here as a third speaker, no name needed, adding a little variety to the mix.

utterances.label: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: Notice how each of us keeps a steady and distinct tone, which is exactly what the system listens for.

utterances.label: SPEAKER_01
utterances.text: The pipeline groups every speaker's turns, then asks a person to confirm who each voice really is.

utterances.label: SPEAKER_02
utterances.text: Some voices it recognizes on its own, and the rest it leaves for you to decide with confidence.

utterances.label: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: That is the whole idea here. You always stay in control of the final label for every speaker.

utterances.label: SPEAKER_01
utterances.text: Once the run finishes, you review the evidence and either accept a match or assign a new name.

utterances.label: SPEAKER_02
utterances.text: It only takes a moment, and then your transcript reads with the right speaker on every line.

utterances.label: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: Thanks for following along. When you're ready, submit your own audio and try the full flow yourself.
